name: radare2 (r2pm)
description: r2pm clones a recipe repo and executes an embedded shell script with no hash/GPG verification.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: r2pm is a package-management channel, separate from the primary radare2 updater. Its source supports Git and archive package sources; the review does not establish an independent package-signature policy or certify the original vulnerability classification.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot rather than historical release re-verification; this review is limited to r2pm's package database/source/archive path and does not establish controls in remote repositories or package build dependencies.

original_evidence.text: | radare2 (r2pm) | github.com/radareorg/radare2 | C (native); `r2pm` package manager | Y — r2pm plugin/package manager (no core-binary self-updater found) | manual (`r2pm -i <pkg>` / `-U` must be explicitly invoked) | Y — clones the package-recipe DB and **executes an embedded shell script** (`R2PM_INSTALL()` block) via `r_sys_cmd`/`system()`-family calls to build & install packages; recipes may also `curl`/`wget` arbitrary further files | https for the package DB (`git clone` of `https://github.com/radareorg/radare2-pm`); `curl`/`wget` fallback for any additional URLs a package recipe defines — those URLs are untrusted/author-defined, not vetted by r2pm | no | **none** — no hash/checksum/GPG/signature check found anywhere in `r2pm.c` | none | `libr/main/r2pm.c:8` (`R2PM_GITURL "https://github.com/radareorg/radare2-pm"`); `r2pm.c:176` (`git clone --depth=1 ... "%s" "%s"`); `r2pm.c:1073,1251` (extraction of `"\nR2PM_INSTALL() {\n"` script block from recipe text, later executed); `r2pm.c:777-813` (curl/wget download + tar/unzip extraction helpers); repo-wide grep for `sha256|sha1|gpg|verify|checksum|signature` in `r2pm.c` returned **zero matches** |

fields.label: has_updater
fields.value: Y — r2pm plugin/package manager (no core-binary self-updater found)

fields.label: downloads_and_executes
fields.value: Y — clones the package-recipe DB and **executes an embedded shell script** (`R2PM_INSTALL()` block) via `r_sys_cmd`/`system()`-family calls to build & install packages; recipes may also `curl`/`wget` arbitrary further files

fields.label: transport
fields.value: https for the package DB (`git clone` of `https://github.com/radareorg/radare2-pm`); `curl`/`wget` fallback for any additional URLs a package recipe defines — those URLs are untrusted/author-defined, not vetted by r2pm

fields.label: payload_verification
fields.value: **none** — no hash/checksum/GPG/signature check found anywhere in `r2pm.c`
